answer: The nadir index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 346 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the harbor. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the horizon queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. The fee repeats 15 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
